text.name: Breeze the Falcon
text.description:
{Breeze the Falcon}

Breeze the Falcon increases your Scouting radius by +2.
text.event: During your journey you hear the sounds of the fight. You came up to the sounds and see that a band of rogues had attacked the lonely hunter. You decide to help the hunter and defeat the rogues, but hunter is deadly wounded. Before his end, he asks you to take care of his bird, Breeze the Falcon.
